sample: 1 in 20 conditions by hashtext, then ALL fills of each sampled condition inside the window. Whole markets are kept intact so the pair reconstruction is not cut in half by the sampler.
encoding: each fill is [condition_index, outcome_index, is_sell, price_x10000, size_x100, ts_minus_t0, detected_minus_ts, venue_minus_ts_or_null, source_index]. Times in seconds.
prior_inventory_encoding: each entry is [condition_index, qty_outcome0_x100, qty_outcome1_x100, fills] for fills STRICTLY BEFORE the window. A condition ABSENT from this array had no recorded Ferrari fill before the window; trades begins 2026-03-31, so absence is not proof of no position, only of no record.
